card.title: B-24 LIBERATOR
card.flavorText: The Consolidated B-24 Liberator was an American heavy bomber used by the Allies during WWII. The B-24 was used for a wide variety of roles, for example, for heavy bombing, antisubmarine warfare and for maritime patrol and reconnaissance missions. The aircraft holds the record of being the worlds most produced heavy bomber in the world, with almost 19,000 units built.
